report-lib-ts.description: A small TypeScript library plus CSS, with subtler traps. Tests pin every exported function's output; the build pins the CSS.

mutations.why: Without the 'impossible' instanceof check, LegacyUser is unused, TypeScript drops the import, and legacyUser.ts never registers the legacy-csv serializer.
a ? a : b falls back on every falsy value; a ?? b keeps an empty nickname.
Object shorthand turns the variable names into output keys, so shorter names change the JSON.
parseInt without a radix reads 0x1F as hex; adding radix 10 returns 0.
return inside a forEach callback skips one item; inside for...of it leaves the function.
